faqs.question: How do I book a table and choose chairs?
faqs.answer: You can book online on our Reservations page (/reservations). Select your date and arrival time, pick your table on our interactive 2D floor plan, and select your individual chairs. Reservation is free with instant confirmation.

faqs.question: What is your delivery fee and delivery time?
faqs.answer: We deliver hot and fresh within 30 minutes. Our flat delivery fee is $5.00 for all orders within our gourmet delivery radius.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD). You can pay our delivery rider in cash upon receiving your hot meal.

faqs.question: What are the opening and closing hours of AQS Restaurant?
faqs.answer: AQS Restaurant is open: Monday – Thursday: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM | Friday – Saturday: 11:00 AM – 12:00 AM (Midnight) | Sunday: 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: Where is AQS Restaurant located?
faqs.answer: AQS Restaurant is located at 123 Luxury Avenue, Gourmet District. You can reach our front desk by phone at +92 300 1234567 or by email at contact@aqsrestaurant.com.

faqs.question: How can I order food online?
faqs.answer: Visit our Menu page (/menu), click "Add" on any dish to add it to your cart, and proceed to Checkout (/checkout) with Cash on Delivery.

faqs.question: How many chairs are available per table?
faqs.answer: We have tables ranging from intimate 2-chair romantic tables up to 8-chair presidential banquet tables across 4 zones: Window Terrace, Main Dining, VIP Lounge, and Chef Garden.
